speed.measurement_caveat: Filesystem timestamp interval includes a failed first preflight, one recovered Counterplay episode, a second full preflight, and orchestration gaps. Treat this as observed workflow throughput, not a clean controlled comparison with Round430.
speed.timing_semantics: Action-selection includes policy inference and baseline opponent scoring; nested fields must not be summed. Timings are measured worker episode telemetry, not wall-clock critical-path fractions.

opportunities.name: Training record parsing and transition preparation
opportunities.evidence: 87.7 s of PPO sample preparation; extraction 27.8 s, input building 20.4 s, JSON row load/validation 20.2 s.
opportunities.next: Profile and optimize extraction/input building while preserving audited transition and tensor parity.

opportunities.name: Policy inference and action scoring during rollouts
opportunities.evidence: 81.8 ms mean action-selection time per episode; 46.2 ms is nested policy inference. Public Counterplay baseline scoring is 25.4 ms mixed average.
opportunities.next: Batch requests across rollout workers; profile public counterplay scoring/cache effectiveness and p95 decision latency.

opportunities.name: Observation encoding
opportunities.next: Reuse compact arrays and cache static team/dex features; preserve closed-sheet leakage checks.

opportunities.name: Trajectory persistence and repeat audits
opportunities.evidence: 20.1 ms mean persistence per episode; rollout files total about 4.16 GB before recovery. This run required a recovered episode and a second audit.
opportunities.next: Buffer writes and avoid redundant full scans through a verifiable incremental manifest; do not weaken the row-level integrity gate.

opportunities.name: Showdown engine
opportunities.evidence: 30.4 ms mean per episode, approximately 15.4% of measured episode time.
opportunities.next: Retain Showdown as reference; optimize only after profiling full rollout critical path shows an engine hotspot.
